description: Use when you need to know what is new or whether the data changed since you last looked. The latest releases of the Greencyclepedia data files: the version to cite, which datasets changed, records added and removed, and where the dated copy of each release lives, plus new_sources: the news sources and partners added in the last 30 days, with the date added and what each covers. Example arguments: {"limit":3}.

limit.description: How many items to return, at most 20.

name: get_changes
title: Recent dataset changes
